verdict.description: PASS = no findings above LOW; PASS_WITH_FIXES = only LOWs remain, consolidator can auto-fix; BLOCKS = at least one BLOCKER or HIGH that gates shipping

verdict_reason.description: One-line rationale. Cite the single BLOCKER/HIGH driving BLOCKS, or 'no findings above LOW' for PASS_WITH_FIXES, or empty string for PASS.

rationale.description: One paragraph: what breaks, why, what to verify. <=200 chars.
